# Acronym consistency

An inline acronym definition, a Title-Case expansion phrase immediately followed
by the acronym in parentheses (for example, `Some Expanded Phrase (SEP)`), whose
acronym appears in the project glossary, shares at least one significant word with
the glossary's expansion for that acronym. Significant words are compared with
stopwords and single-character tokens ignored; an overlap of at least one word is
accepted. A definition whose words do not overlap the glossary expansion is
flagged; an acronym not in the glossary contributes no finding. The glossary is
parsed from the project's glossary register into an acronym-to-words map. The
definition and glossary regexes, the stopword set, and the overlap logic are fixed
in the check implementation; the glossary-register path, the scan scope, and the
exempt-file set are project configuration.
